svg.metadata: {"source_asset": {"id": "core.symbol.dashed_arrow", "name": "Dashed Arrow", "category": "pathway-symbol", "tags": ["dashed arrow", "indirect effect", "pathway", "connector", "flow"], "description": "Original vector indirect-relation connector with evenly spaced dashes, a directional head, source node, and editable semantic regions.", "file": "svg/dashed_arrow.svg", "source_type": "original_vector_draft", "license": "CC0-1.0", "provenance": "Original vector draft created for Figure Studio from a generic scientific concept; no proprietary reference image, scraping, tracing, or protected asset-library recreation was used.", "style_family": "figure-studio-soft-line-v1", "review_status": "visual_reviewed_2026_07_18", "style_status": "soft_line_v1_pathway_symbol_refresh", "mvp_quality": "curated", "editable_region_count": 4, "reviewer_notes": "Retained the familiar indirect-effect grammar while regularizing dash spacing, enlarging the terminal head, and matching the thinner connector weight used across the refreshed family.", "editable_color_regions": [{"id": "stroke", "label": "Indirect-relation dashes", "default": "#2A9D8F", "paint": "stroke"}, {"id": "head", "label": "Arrow head", "default": "#2A9D8F", "paint": "fill"}, {"id": "accent", "label": "Source node", "default": "#F4A261", "paint": "fill"}, {"id": "outline", "label": "Arrow outline", "default": "#26323D", "paint": "stroke"}]}, "source_archive": "scientific-packs(1).zip", "source_svg": "scientific-packs/core-biology/svg/dashed_arrow.svg", "output_style": "Style 4", "batch": "007", "source_record_is_unmodified": true}
